blocks.prompt: 8. Find the integer \(b\) such that the average value of \(f(x) = 2 + 4x - 3x^{2}\) on the interval \([2, b]\) equals \(-7\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh average value ka sawal hai, lekin is dafa interval ka aakhri sira \(b\) maloom nahin.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x)\) aur yeh ke \([2, b]\) par average \(-7\) hai.
Rule kaunsa? \(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\).
Plan: formula ko \(-7\) ke barabar rakho, integrate karo, fraction hatao, cubic equation ko factorise karo, aur sirf woh \(b\) lo jo \(2\) se bara ho.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = 2 + 4x - 3x^{2}\), \([2, b]\) par average \(-7\).
Maloom karna: integer \(b\).
Tareeqa: \(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{b-2}\int_{2}^{b} f(x)\,dx\); \([2, b]\) interval tabhi hai jab \(b > 2\).

Equation banayein
\[\dfrac{2b + 2b^{2} - b^{3} - 4}{b - 2} = -7\]
\[2b + 2b^{2} - b^{3} - 4 = -7b + 14\]
\[b^{3} - 2b^{2} - 9b + 18 = 0\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(b - 2\) se multiply kiya, phir sab terms ek taraf la kar \(-1\) se multiply kiya taa ke \(b^{3}\) positive ho.
Dhyan dein: \(-7(b - 2) = -7b + 14\); minus dono terms par lagta hai.

Factorise karein
\[b^{2}(b - 2) - 9(b - 2) = 0\]
\[(b - 2)(b - 3)(b + 3) = 0\]
\[b = 2,\ 3,\ -3\]
Kyun: pehle do terms se \(b^{2}\) aur aakhri do se \(-9\) common nikala, to \((b - 2)\) dono mein aa gaya. Phir \(b^{2} - 9 = (b - 3)(b + 3)\) (difference of squares).

Sahi root chunein
\(b = 2\) se interval ki lambai zero ho jati hai (aur hum \(b - 2\) se divide kar chuke hain, jo zero nahin ho sakta). \(b = -3\) to 2 se chhota hai, is liye \([2, b]\) interval hi nahin banta. Is liye \(b = 3\).
